name: lark
description: Connect Claude to LarkSuite — messaging, docs, Bitable/Base, calendar, and tasks.
long_description: Wraps the official `@larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp` MCP server (larksuite/lark-openapi-mcp) so Claude can read and act on Lark/Feishu messaging, docs, Bitable/Base records, calendar events, and tasks. No fork, no reimplementation — this bundle vendors the official package unmodified. Enter your Lark custom app's App ID and App Secret when installing; they are stored encrypted by Claude Desktop and never appear in chat, logs, or this repository.

appId.title: Lark App ID
appId.description: App ID from your custom app on the Lark Open Platform console (open.larksuite.com).

appSecret.title: Lark App Secret
appSecret.description: App Secret for the same app. Stored encrypted in your OS keychain/credential manager, never in plaintext.
